notes.title: May 11 Update
notes.notes:
Dear paper fans, 


Thank you for your comments and suggestions on Paper Bride. We have optimized and fixed some issues:

1. Optimized the text of game languages ( including Japanese, English, Korean, Vietnamese, and Thai translations).

2. Optimized the content of the second chapter within the second chapter of the book "The Sutra Pavilion" from the year '醜' to the year '丑'. 

If you encounter any other mission problems or bugs, you can join our discord channel to communicate~
discord：https://discord.gg/kPNcQB4FdC
Thank you very much for your support of Paper Bride 2 Zangling Village!

notes.title: May 7 UPDATE
notes.notes:
Dear PaperFans，
Thank you very much for your opinions and suggestions about Paper Bride. We have optimized and fixed for more feedback. The specific content is as follows:

1. Fixed the problem of incorrect display of the translation of the red letters (Korean, Vietnamese, Thai) when viewing the notebook at the mirror in Chapter 1.
2. Optimized the display of photos, adjusted the unlocking order of Scenarios page.
3. Fixed the problem of black screen. If you still encounter this issue, please join our discord channel.

If you encounter any other mission problems or bugs, you can join our discord channel to communicate~
discord：https://discord.gg/kPNcQB4FdC
Thank you very much for your support of Paper Bride 2 Zangling Village!

notes.title: Paper Bride 2 Zangling Village steam version will be globally released on May 6
notes.notes:
Dear friends:

I am afraid I have some bad news that due to a Steam review issue, we had to adjust the release date to May 6th.
Sorry for the inconvenience to you all and also thank you very much for your support and patience for the paper bride series.
Sincerely apology to all the fans who are looking forward to our game! We will also continue to rise to the challenge, continue to polish, work harder, and strive to officially meet you on May 6!

【Release date change】

April 28, 2022 → May 6, 2022


Paper Bride 2：Zangling Village
Release on  May 6th

notes.title: Paper Bride2 Zangling Village Release on April 28
notes.notes:
Some will even interpret the very dream they are dreaming, and only when they awake do they know it was a dream. 

The dream, the dream again, the same nightmare that has been haunting me since I was a child, I always dream that there is someone who is a bride in a paper dress tied to an old tree in Zangling Village…
To resolve this nightmare, I could only return to the place in my dream - Zangling Village.

[previewyoutube=VvgvLbSA7lM;full][/previewyoutube]

PAPER BRIDE2 ZANGLING VILLAGE is a Chinese Horror Puzzle Game, the Remastered Version will be available worldwide on April 28th（PST）on Steam. 
Exclusive achievements, collectible art sets, and original sound DLC will be available at the same time. Want to uncover the secret of Zangling village? Join into your wish list!
